choice.basis: The dashboard is a single-axis 'Kidney vs Liver Transplants' chart. At the 2017 tick, the blue solid-line endpoint (Kidney) and the red square marker (Liver) are plotted at the exact same vertical position, indicating equal transplant volumes for the reporting year. The option label 'matched-volume review' semantically corresponds to this equal-volume state.
choice.option_label: Route the 2017 transplant comparison to matched-volume review
